source: Apache Commons Compress GitHub Pull Request and source history
technology: Apache Commons Compress / Java / TAR PAX extended-header parsing
error_description: A TAR archive with an exceptionally large PAX extended header can cause excessive memory use while metadata is parsed. The affected behavior is reached through both streaming and file-based TAR reading.
i_base: TarArchiveInputStream traverses TAR entries and handles PAX metadata records.
TarFile provides a separate file-based entry traversal path for TAR archives.
Both reader paths delegate special TAR record handling to the shared TarUtils helper.
The shared PAX parser receives the header's declared size and accumulates metadata fields into a map.
The reported defect concerns parsing exceptionally large PAX metadata without a default upper bound on the memory admitted for that header.

ccdg.details: Streaming reader passes PAX record metadata into the common handler.
File-based reader uses the same common handler for PAX records.
Local and global PAX header branches call the shared parser with the declared header size.
Key/value records are stored in the resulting metadata map; oversized header data can cause excessive memory consumption if not bounded.

provenance.pre_fix_expected_observation: The 20 MiB PAX header was not rejected; the regression test failed with 'Should have thrown MemoryLimitException'.
provenance.fixed_expected_observation: The same regression test passed; MemoryLimitException was thrown for the oversized header.
